gen-gf-underdog-gf-ysabeau-sc: Underdog draws every curve with no swell or pinch, its c flung open like a horseshoe, while Ysabeau SC answers with a gaping c of its own. Modern and sans.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Wire-smooth strokes with no thick and thin at all give Underdog its swagger. And ZCOOL XiaoWei brings a gentle, dip-pen variation in weight, a quiet foil for that bold flatness.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antiq: Zen Kaku Gothic Antique reads modern and clean, its t crossbar matching the stem and each bend running smooth. Underdog is the showman with that horseshoe c; Zen Kaku Gothic Antique is the steady sans.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-aclonica: Commanding and distinctive, Unica One squeezes out strokes like toothpaste. Aclonica stretches wide beneath it, its mild thick-thin shifts smoothing the reading pace into something you feel more than see.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Unica One has horizontals just as heavy as its verticals, with huge open lowercase curves. But Alumni Sans SC runs squeezed and oversized in the lowercase, with only a modest stress in its curves.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-cal-sans: Big, bold, and wide open. Unica One keeps one thickness throughout, and Cal Sans follows with its own single stroke width, short ascenders, and a tall x-height beneath it.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-carlito: Carlito reads clearly with open round letters, tight spacing like thread on a spool, and small capitals beside big lowercase. Unica One keeps one constant stroke width above.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-days-one: Chunky and confident, Unica One matches its curves to its stems exactly. Yet Days One fills the line with a big x-height and rope-ladder rungs of spacing, making sentences march along.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-epunda-sans: Smooth, skimming, and sure of itself, Unica One never changes stroke weight. Epunda Sans follows with oversized e and a counters and trimmed sidebearings, so lines glide along comfortably.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-farro: Tall, stark, and unmistakable. Unica One excels at a huge lowercase eye and uniform strokes, while Farro does its best work with compressed ascenders and zero stroke contrast.
